cells.gaps: No source found names a second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above: the Brazzaville centre built in 2021 is named with no Tier.
cells.note: ARPCE's Pointe-Noire centre, in service since February 2024, is state-owned and Tier 3+ on the operator's word (COG-005, COG-011). The State's earlier Brazzaville centre (COG-012) has no Tier stated, so not two.
